chunks: And from al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) he said:
If a believer knew what reward lies for him in suffering tribulations, he would wish he could be cut into pieces with a scissor.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Al-Sadiq (the Truthful), a title for Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him)
key_terms.بِالْمَقَارِيضِ: With scissors or shears (plural of miqraz)
key_terms.يُقْرَضَ: To be cut or sliced (passive verb)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a believer during tribulations according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explains that the magnitude of reward for a believer in times of hardship is so great that, if fully known, one would eagerly desire even extreme physical suffering to attain it. This highlights the spiritual value of patience during afflictions.
